recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white photograph of a mundane, slightly dated bedroom interior featuring a radiator, dresser, and bed, juxtaposed with a dynamic, full-color or high-contrast motocross rider jumping through the air in the upper right quadrant with visible motion trails.
coreVisualRelationships: Static, gritty interior vs. dynamic, airborne subject
Monochromatic environment vs. vibrant, saturated typography
Horizontal room lines vs. diagonal motion of the motorcycle
coreInvariants: Motion blur streaks behind the motorcycle
High-contrast lighting from a window source

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The motorcycle and rider occupy the upper right quadrant, scaled to appear as if jumping across the room.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, textured bed in the lower right provides a heavy base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left text, follows the diagonal path of the motorcycle downward toward the bed, then circles back through the vertical lines of the radiator.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper left and center allows the typography to breathe against the wallpaper texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated grayscale for the photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the shadows of the furniture and motorcycle tires.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary script lettering and cyan/teal for the secondary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the B&W image; extreme saturation in the graphic overlays.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Secondary text is ultra-condensed with high verticality
Primary script features a heavy drop shadow and thick, uniform stroke weight
Script is angled at approximately 30 degrees upward
characterSpecificRedesigns: Connected lowercase letters in the script
Elongated stems in the sans-serif display text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-energy script paired with rigid, architectural sans-serif.

preserve: Wide letter spacing of top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the verticality and narrowness of the top display text.
Provides the casual, energetic 80s script feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, high-contrast black and white photo of a 1970s bedroom with a radiator, dresser, and bed. Composite a motocross rider in mid-air jump in the upper right, with white motion blur streaks trailing behind the bike.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of ultra-condensed cyan sans-serif text across the very top with wide tracking. Below it, add a large, bold red script title at a 30-degree upward angle with a black drop shadow, partially overlapping the motorcycle's front wheel.

verificationChecks: Is the room B&W and the text colored?
Does the motorcycle have motion trails?
Is the script text tilted upwards?
Is the top text ultra-condensed and widely spaced?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the motorcycle
Exact facial features of the rider
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast in the B&W areas
Ensure the red script has a distinct drop shadow
Verify the cyan text is justified across the top width
Confirm the motorcycle appears to be 'entering' the frame from the right
recipe.reuseFormula: Gritty B&W Interior + Dynamic Action Subject + Bi-color Retro Typography
